attempts.text:
**The anchor is a single spine column.** Column 0, `yeaH`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls; the model names it in 98% of calls at 0.15 bits. Then the graph opens: columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 82% of calls.

**The first forks run through `yeaG` to `ydjF`.** Columns 1 to 7 are persistent forks at 87 to 89%, then `ydjL` to `ydjF`, columns 8 to 14, are shell forks at 70 to 82%. This is where the model hesitates most: column 8, `ydjL`, 0.90 bits, in a region of plasticity in 82% of calls; column 10, `ydjJ`, 0.87 bits; column 9, `ydjK`, 0.78 bits, and the fewest named of the window, 25%. A parallel branch of 14 families, `cdgI` to `yoaG`, runs through columns 1 to 14, carried by 10 to 11% of chromosomes.

**Persistent forks continue to `yniD`.** `pncA` to `ydjZ` and `ydjX` to `yniD` sit at 81 to 89%, with `ansA`, `sppA`, `ydjA` and `ydjY` variable between them. The `ast` genes, [[succinylornithine and succinylglutamate catabolism]], and the `chb` genes, [[diacetylchitobiose transport]], are here. A branch of 13 families, `yeaW` to `sdaA`, spans columns 20 to 32, and one of 25 families, `yoaE` to `pphA`, spans columns 34 to 58, each carried by 11% of chromosomes.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 64 to 78, `thrS` to `hemP`, are variable at 74 to 84%, all persistent. Column 79, `aroH`, is a fork at 63%. Across the window the model names 93% of genes at 0.29 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 66% against 96% outside, and hesitates 1.22 bits against 0.16.

label: yeaH
facts:
WINDOW: the yeaH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yeaH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,952 to 2,031 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yeaH once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.29 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,869 calls, named 97%, 0.14 bits; shell 5,915 calls, named 65%, 1.08 bits; cloud 176 calls, named 14%, 4.34 bits. Outside an RGP 37,996 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 4,964 calls, named 66%, 1.22 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 55 fork, 24 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.22 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (66% against 96%); 4,964 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 8 (ydjL) 0.90 bits, RGP 82%; column 10 (ydjJ) 0.87 bits, RGP 82%; column 9 (ydjK) 0.78 bits, RGP 82%. The 8 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 73%, 0.55 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 95%, 0.26 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-82%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yeaH "YeaH/YhbH family protein". named 98%; 0.15 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-82%. named 25-99.6% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 9, named 25%; most hesitant at column 8, 0.90 bits.
   a second branch of 14 families through columns 1-14, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, all P; the branch's families: cdgI, dgcJ, yeaK, yoaI, yeaL, nimR, nimT, yeaO, yoaF, dgcP, yoaK, yoaJ, yeaQ, yoaG
   a second branch of 13 families through columns 20-32, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, 11 P, 2 S; the branch's families: yeaW, yeaX, rnd, fadD, yeaY, tsaB, yoaA, yoaB, yoaC, yoaH, pabB, nudL, sdaA
   a second branch of 25 families through columns 34-58, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all P; the branch's families: yoaE, yoaL, manX, manY, manZ, yobD, mntP, rlmA, cspE, yobF, yebO, mgrB, yobH, kdgR, yebQ, htpX, prc, proQ, msrC, yebS, yebT, rsmF, yebV, yebW, pphA
